title: Hearty Flaky Irish Chicken Pie
description: A traditional Irish dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a flaky crust, made with a chicken stock cube and laminated puff pastry, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken, stock, vegetables, onion, and mustard, and mix well.
Spoon the chicken mixture into a hot pot vessel.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the melted butter.
Place the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
